[center][size=3]Hello! This is my first mod here! I've been working on this for some time now but I just had a super big move I had to get through before I could add finishing touches.

[/i][/b][i][size=1]Some of the color names might not make total sense, this is because I did some changes after I did all the code writing so let's just ignore that for now..
